verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail runs on top of connected Gmail and Outlook accounts, but the evidence never documents a feature that imports mail history or contacts from another provider or client. Connecting an existing Gmail or Outlook account is an adjacent capability that relies on the host platform, not a migration or import tool. Mail-client import is a fair question for this kind of product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
